text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the workplace in many ways. One important change is automation, where machines do repetitive tasks that people used to do. This saves time and reduces mistakes. Many companies also use AI productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, to help employees work faster and better. However, AI does not replace people completely. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming common, where workers use AI to support their decisions and creative ideas. Of course, these changes mean some jobs will look different, and workers will need new skills. Overall, AI offers both opportunities and challenges in the modern workplace.
